name: Kohanai Reiri
source:
[b]The Cheekily Charming Junior, Still Wet Behind the Ears as a Detective Apprentice[/b]

Reiri is the new part-timer at Trigger Detective Agency, bringing a breath of fresh air.

Living next door to Kai, she's all about keeping things chill and easy-going, lighting up the room with her bright vibe. Sure, she might miss the obvious now and then, but don't let that fool you—she's got a razor-sharp edge when it counts. Plus, she's got this crafty, sassy side that's hard to miss.

Vamps? Yeah, she's not exactly their number-one fan.

Race: Hume
Likes: Her parents, baseball, cooking, macarons, cherry blossoms
Dislikes: Vamps, blood, insects
Skills/Hobbies: Can throw a softball 50 meters
Losses: Her parents and her hometown
